title: ProgramStayDocument
description: Server-owned per-guest stay assignment: which hotel (and optionally which room block / room label) a guest occupies, with planned dates and hotel-side progression timestamps. One document per guest per stay; guests sharing a room have separate stays with the same roomLabel.

guestId.description: Exactly one guest per stay; roommates are separate stays sharing roomLabel.

hotelId.description: programHotels doc the guest stays at; must belong to the same program.

roomBlockId.description: programRoomBlocks doc this stay draws capacity from; null for ad-hoc assignments outside any block.

roomLabel.description: Physical room assignment (e.g. '412') set by the hotel desk; null until allocated.

startsAt.description: Planned check-in; null while the stay is requested but undated.

status.description: Stay lifecycle: held (reserved, not confirmed) → confirmed → checkedIn → checkedOut; cancelled releases block capacity.

roomReadyAt.description: When the hotel marked the room ready for this guest.

hotelArrivedAt.description: When the guest actually reached the hotel (hotel-desk observed).

source.description: How the stay row entered the program — mirrors programTravelLegs.source.
